snippet.title: Lost Rift Steam Next Fest demo trailer - PC Gaming Show 2025
snippet.description:
As revealed during the PC Gaming Show 2025, survival-meets-extraction shooter Lost Rift is in-line for a shiny new Steam Next Fest demo - available from June 9.
